---
title: "Historical fixed-parameter ePC-SAFT evaluation"
subtitle: "True-species activity evidence retained for traceability, not parameter adoption"
---

::: {.callout-warning}
This is historical evidence. The fixed parameter artifact is not a finalized
joint regression and cannot be exported as a predictive MEA parameter set.
:::

## Scope and ownership

This analysis owns the retained true-species activity-equilibrium evaluation
for MEA–CO₂–H₂O. It records the source-checked reaction constants, exact
parameter artifact, solver diagnostics, equilibrium rows, pressure/speciation
metrics, and claim gates. The numerical generator was retired; this page and
the renderer read retained tables only.

The model-run status is `model_ran_success`, while validation and claim
permission remain controlled by the residual acceptance audit. The retained
results therefore document what the historical fixed configuration did, not
what a current process model may claim.
